      "evidence": "Documentation updates in doc/assumeutxo.md and release notes follow directly from the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a docs PR because documentation modifications merely describe the updated assumeutxo workflow."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/base.cpp with a 1-line mechanical adjustment.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter optional index logic or data integrity."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mentioned in description regarding mempool coordination avoidance, but does not alter mempool structures, policy, or validation rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Avoids running during active mempool processing, but does not touch mempool code or policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes runtime local service demotion and drops unused helper in src/net.h.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Minor downstream cleanup from moving snapshot loading prior to P2P startup; does not alter network protocols or peer handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to deprecate and hide public usage of the loadtxoutset RPC.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retires a public RPC method in favor of a startup argument. Removing public use of `loadtxoutset` changes the programmatic interface, though the RPC itself is retained as a hidden method for fuzzing."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates functional and fuzz tests for assumeutxo, but does not alter test infrastructure or harnesses.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications pin the updated assumeutxo startup behavior rather than altering testing framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches contrib/completions/bash/bitcoind.bash to add completion for the new argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A single completion script line following a node argument change does not make this a tools PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds -loadtxoutset handling in src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The startup argument handling exists specifically for assumeutxo validation behavior, which belongs to validation rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies assumeutxo chainstate initialization in src/validation.cpp and src/node/utxo_snapshot.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Moving snapshot import to node startup eliminates significant runtime validation cache flushing and concurrency hazards. Loading before networking avoids 'temporary import cache resizing' and race conditions from concurrent block arrivals while resolving issue #36346."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies test/functional/wallet_assumeutxo.py to use the new startup argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Touches no wallet implementation code and only updates an assumeutxo integration test."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
